record.context_brief: Serre invariance on quartic-threefold Kuznetsov components
record.original_question: If X is a quartic threefold, are the stability conditions sigma(s, q, mu) on its Kuznetsov component Serre-invariant for some choice of (s, q)?

evidence.quote: Question 5.35. If X is a quartic threefold, are the stability conditions sigma(s, q, mu) Serre-invariant for some (s, q)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^4$ be a smooth quartic threefold (a smooth hypersurface of degree four). Its bounded derived category of coherent sheaves admits a semiorthogonal decomposition
$$D^b(X) = \langle \mathcal{K}u(X),\; \mathcal{O}_X,\; \mathcal{O}_X(1) \rangle,$$
where the Kuznetsov component $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is defined as the right orthogonal $\{ E \in D^b(X) : \mathrm{Hom}^\bullet(\mathcal{O}_X, E) = \mathrm{Hom}^\bullet(\mathcal{O}_X(1), E) = 0 \}$. The category $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is a $\mathbb{C}$-linear triangulated category with Serre functor $S_{\mathcal{K}u(X)}$.

Following the general inducing construction for Kuznetsov components of Fano threefolds of index one, one obtains a family of Bridgeland stability conditions $\sigma(s,q,\mu)$ on $\mathcal{K}u(X)$, parametrized by real numbers $(s, q, \mu)$ lying in a suitable region, constructed by tilting the standard heart of $D^b(X)$ using slope and tilt-stability with parameters $s$ and $q$ (with $\mu$ an auxiliary weight), and then restricting an induced stability condition to $\mathcal{K}u(X)$.

A stability condition $\sigma$ on $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is called Serre-invariant if there exists $\widetilde{g} \in \widetilde{\mathrm{GL}}_2^+(\mathbb{R})$ such that
$$S_{\mathcal{K}u(X)} \cdot \sigma = \sigma \cdot \widetilde{g}.$$

Question: Does there exist a choice of parameters $(s, q)$ (with some admissible $\mu$) such that the stability condition $\sigma(s, q, \mu)$ on $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is Serre-invariant?
artifact.category_tag: Bridgeland stability conditions on Kuznetsov components
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work characterizes Serre-invariant stability conditions on Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds (cubic threefolds, quartic double solids, Gushel-Mukai threefolds) via a homological-dimension criterion, and constructs unique-up-to-$\widetilde{\mathrm{GL}}_2^+(\mathbb{R})$ Serre-invariant stability conditions in those index-2 / Enriques-category cases. For smooth quartic threefolds (index 1, Picard rank 1, $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ a CY-category of fractional dimension), no source found explicitly confirms or refutes Serre-invariance of the induced $\sigma(s,q,\mu)$ family. The status appears to remain unresolved in the literature accessible by search.

status_evidence.title: Stability manifolds of Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: a stability condition σ on Ku(X) is Serre-invariant if and only if its homological dimension is at most 2
status_evidence.claim: Provides a Serre-invariance criterion for cubic threefolds, quartic double solids, and GM threefolds, but does not address smooth quartic threefolds in P^4 specifically.

status_evidence.title: Serre-invariant stability conditions and Ulrich bundles on cubic threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: all known stability conditions on Ku(X) of a cubic threefold are Serre-invariant
status_evidence.claim: Resolves the analogous question for cubic threefolds but not for quartic threefolds.
